findings.title: IDOR: GET /api/items/:id did not scope the query by team
findings.impact: A member of team B could read any item of team A by id.
findings.precondition: authenticated member of any team, item id
findings.fix: Scope the query with eq(items.teamId, session.teamId) in one shared data-access helper.

findings.title: Possible missing rate limit on the add-link route
findings.missing: whether the edge proxy or the app applies a per-session limit
findings.humanCommand: for i in $(seq 1 100); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"url":"https://e.co","title":"t"}' localhost:3000/api/items; done | sort | uniq -c

findings.title: Verbose error body on a malformed JSON body
findings.disproof: The handler returns a fixed 400 without echoing the parser message; checked in request.json() catch block and in the response snapshot.
